data.name: Nadia
data.gender_notes: Nadia is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ن-د-ي (n-d-y), 'to call, announce'. Nādiyā means 'caller'. Its root is ن-د-ي (n-d-y). A common Muslim female name. Nadia is a Arabic name meaning “Caller; announcer; (also) hope”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nadia expresses “Caller; announcer; (also) hope”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ن-د-ي (n-d-y), 'to call, announce'. Nādiyā means 'caller'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nadia total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
